exclude_selectors drops entire subtree unlike strip_tags which keeps children

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<body><div class="wrapper"><p>Inner paragraph</p></div><p>Outer text</p></body>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(exclude_selectors: ['.wrapper']))
puts result.content.inspect
```
